name: Plath
desc:
Plath is a Celtor NPC.

Plath can be found kneeling on a rock in the [Kyrsan Wilds](location:kyrsan_wilds). They guide the player on how to enter the city through the [Great Library of New Kyrsa](location:new_kyrsa).
additional_info: -   They are old, at least 70+ as seen from being in Stage 4 of aging.
